message:
The CMake source path is wrong. The fuzzing directory is at `/gt/_work/src/fuzzing`, and the CMakeLists.txt is at `/gt/_work/src/CMakeLists.txt`. So from `/gt/_work/src/fuzzing`, the source is `..` not `../..`. Let me fix:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src/fuzzing && rm -rf build && CC=clang CXX=clang++ CFLAGS="-O1 -g -fsanitize=address" CXXFLAGS="-O1 -g -fsanitize=address" cmake -DFUZZER=ON -DLIB_FUZZING_ENGINE="-fsanitize=fuzzer" .. 2>&1 | tail -20'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
